title: Reorg over-count + reorg-reinclusion DOUBLE-COUNT: the cursor advances on the un-finalized latest block (no confirmation/finality lag), so an orphaned external Transfer is counted though it never settled, and a re-included Transfer is counted twice
description: THE GOAL (spec lines 13-22) requires REAL, SETTLED external money; INV-7 (spec 83-87) counts external inflows 'since the last processed block'. blockNow() returns eth_blockNumber = the LATEST (un-finalized) Base block (record-earn.mjs:64), and externalInflow scans up to and including that block (line 101: externalInflow(cursor+1, now)), then the cursor is advanced to that same un-finalized height (line 102). There is NO finality/confirmation margin (grep for confirm/final/safe = none). Base (OP-Stack) latest blocks are NOT final until the L1 batch is posted/justified; they can reorg. Two concrete defects: (1) ORPHAN OVER-COUNT: an external USDC Transfer in block N is counted at wake-time (cursor->N), then block N reorgs and the tx is dropped from the canonical chain — it NEVER settled, yet earn_usdc>0 was written to the ledger the public dashboard reads. That is exactly a 'USDC number that did not come from a genuine settled external payer' = THE GOAL violation. (2) REORG-REINCLUSION DOUBLE-COUNT: the same Transfer is counted at block N (cursor->N), then reorged out of N and RE-MINED into a later canonical block M>N; the next wake scans N+1..now>=M and counts the SAME real payment a SECOND time. The header comment 'cursor advances crash-safely (under-count, never double-count)' (line 9) and the line-102 comment 'never double-counts already-cursored blocks' are FALSE for reorgs because the previously-cursored blocks were not canonical. No test exercises any reorg (grep reorg in test = none).
fix: Apply a finality lag so the cursor and the scan window never include un-finalized blocks. In blockNow(), use the FINALIZED/SAFE head instead of latest: replace `Number(BigInt(await rpc('eth_blockNumber',[])))` with a query of the 'finalized' (or 'safe') tag, e.g. `Number(BigInt((await rpc('eth_getBlockByNumber', ['finalized', false])).number))` (Base supports the finalized/safe block tags), OR subtract a fixed confirmation margin: `const head = Number(BigInt(await rpc('eth_blockNumber',[]))); return head - CONFIRMATIONS;` with CONFIRMATIONS chosen for Base finality. Then externalInflow(cursor+1, finalizedHead) and writeCursorAtomic(finalizedHead) operate only on blocks that can no longer reorg, eliminating both the orphan over-count and the reinclusion double-count. Add a behavioral test that feeds a finalized-head < latest and asserts un-finalized blocks are NOT scanned/cursored.
